title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1100 West Kent Avenue in Missoula, Montana, as the Jeannette Rankin Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1100 West Kent Avenue in Missoula, Montana, as the "Jeannette Rankin Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Missoula, Montana post office building after Jeannette Rankin.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1100 West Kent Avenue in Missoula, Montana, as the Jeannette Rankin Post Office Building. Jeannette Rankin was a Montana politician. The change is symbolic and does not alter how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 13, 2019.
